run_deepclusterv2_training: run the DeepCluster-v2 self-supervised training loop on ImageNet with distributed data parallel
run_train_function: run the train function to perform one epoch of DeepCluster-v2 training with memory bank updates
run_init_memory: run the init_memory function to initialize local memory banks with image embeddings
run_cluster_memory: run the cluster_memory function to perform distributed k-means clustering on memory bank embeddings
run_get_indices_sparse: run the get_indices_sparse function to group array indices by value using a sparse matrix
